'''2016 Worlds Day 2 John Anderson DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[John Anderson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
